A timeless romantic classic that continues to capture hearts! Enjoy O Meri Mehbooba from the blockbuster film Dharam Veer (1977), featuring the charismatic Dharmendra and the ever-graceful Zeenat Aman. Soulfully sung by the legendary Mohammed Rafi, with music composed by Laxmikant-Pyarelal and lyrics penned by Anand Bakshi, this evergreen melody is a beautiful reminder of Bollywood's golden musical era.
